Geographies Served Programs Program Phoolbati District Dhamtari State Chhattisgarh District Dhamtari States Chhattisgarh Phoolbati: Our Phoolbati program focuses on providing access to early childhood education to the children from Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group (PVTG) community who are devoid of it for generations. We establish community-owned learning centres in the affected villages and work with the children, parents and community members on awareness about the need and importance of education. ● Providing access to children from underprivileged communities who are deprived of education through community-owned learning Centre ● Awareness and empowerment towards the needs and importance of education ● Curriculum based on the context, language, interest, and age of the child ● Establishing community library ● Project based and child-led learning ● Developing women from PVTG communities as community leader ● Nutrition supplements for the children Program Ujood District Dhamtari State Chhattisgarh District Dhamtari States Chhattisgarh Ujood: Through our program Ujood, we work upon developing the quality of early childhood education of government anganwadis through capacity building of teachers, supervisors, and parents. We highlight the importance of context based and child-led learning through project and exploration-based pedagogy. Multimodal engagement and systemic inputs are key to our process. ● Strengthening government early childhood education system through capacity building of teachers ● Implementation of Foundational learning as suggested in the NPE 2020 ● Development of learning materials which promote CBCL (Context Based and Child-Led) perspectives and pedagogies ● Developing school environment of government anganwadis ● Research and Advocacy Impact Metrics Number of Children From Pvtg Community Getting Access to Early Childhood Education Program Name Phoolbati Year-wise Metrics 2020-21 40 2021-22 45 2022-23 65 Number of Awc Teachers Trained Program Name Ujood Year-wise Metrics 2020-21 472 2021-22 400 2022-23 91 Number of Children From Government Anganwadis Program Name Ujood Year-wise Metrics 2020-21 2180 2021-22 1300 2022-23 1500 Milestones & Track Record Avaniti has established two programs called Phoolbati and Ujood to provide early childhood education and improve quality of education in government anganwadis. --> --> Leadership Team Ashwini Patil CEO Krishna Puri Operations Demographics & Structure Organisation Strength None M&E Internal, External Assessors No --> Political & Religious Declarations On Affiliation if any No On Deployment Bias if any No --> Registration Details PAN Card AARCA2423M Registration Number U80904PN2018NPL178372 CSR Form 1 CSR00008942 VO ID / Darpan ID MH/2020/0260091 --> 80G AARCA2423MF20241 12A AARCA2423ME20231 FCRA Not Available About Headquarters Pune, Maharashtra Since 2018 Demographies Served Children Teachers Scheduled Tribes --> Impact 1. Providing access to early childhood education to 100+ children from the Kamar community (a PVTG) 2. Outreach to 600 anganwadi teachers, primary school teachers, and functionaries through capacity building workshop 3. Focussed on-site support to 70 anganwadi of Dhamtari district which impact 1400 children Vision and Mission Avaniti's vision is a society where every child's voice and ways of learning are respected, and its mission is to work towards providing access and quality early childhood education to the most disadvantaged children.
